xmldoc.short_description: Return UTC offsets for timezone-aware datetime values.

param_input_item.param_description: A datetime array whose TimeZone property is empty, a fixed offset, local, or a supported timezone name.

param_output_item.param_description: A duration array containing offsets from UTC.

description.p: Return UTC offsets for timezone-aware datetime values.
Named timezone offsets are read from the embedded timezone data. Fixed offsets such as +02:30 are parsed directly.
Array-valued inputs keep their data shape when the operation supports arrays. Scalar operands are expanded where the implementation defines scalar expansion.
